subject: Recap: Redwood demo + next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Stanton <jordan@stantonai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Redwood demo + next steps

Hi Jordan / Lila —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk us through StantonAI's inference bottlenecks. Quick recap from our side and a proposed path forward so we’re aligned: 

What we heard
- Peak latency on batch jobs spikes during model churn, causing missed SLA windows for your edge customers.
- Cost per token for nightly re-runs is a top concern; you want predictable unit economics and simpler model rollouts.

What Redwood can do (POC scope)
- 2-week POC: deploy a dedicated inference pool for one endpoint, enable KV caching + dynamic batching, compare latency/cost vs. current infra.
- Success criteria: median generation latency < 250ms for 95th percentile of realtime tests; >=25% token cost reduction on nightly jobs.

Timeline & next steps
1) Sign simple POC SOW and agree on start window — we suggested May 24 or May 31.
2) Redwood will provision dedicated capacity and run a 3-day smoke test, then handover to your infra team for validation.
3) Joint report and decision point at the end of week 2.

Ballpark commercial 
- POC estimate attached (Redwood-MVP-Pricing.pdf) — this is for the reserved pool + support for the 2-week run.
- Draft SOW attached (SOW-POC-draft.docx) to speed procurement if you’re ready.

Ask
- Can you confirm internal priority for a POC and which start date (May 24 or May 31) works? If you prefer, we can shift the window by a week.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: Redwood-MVP-Pricing.pdf (pdf)]
- [Attachment: SOW-POC-draft.docx (docx)]

If easier, we can hop on a short 15-min call to align on the scope. Otherwise, a quick reply with preferred start date is perfect.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

---
